notes.summary: Rules can now run on triggers other than an object becoming active, and can change the weather.
added: Rule triggers: journal, hour, day, weather, cell_enter, activate, drop, place, use, death, and custom triggers fired by other mods.
The by_player and used_item conditions for interaction triggers.
The StaticSwitcher_G interface is version 6 and adds trigger(); the StaticSwitcherTrigger global event does the same from any script.
changed: A rule with an unknown condition, action or trigger name, a malformed range, or an unknown transform_type is skipped with a warning instead of being loaded without it.
once: true follows the object a rule replaces with, and is recorded by where each effect lives rather than by whether any action reported success.
A module that cannot be read or parsed is skipped instead of stopping every module from loading.
fixed: An item picked up while still queued no longer jams the queue and spams the log.
Two rules that swap an object back and forth no longer replace it forever.
trap, key and global_value entries with lowercase names are no longer discarded when a module loads.
A queued deletion the engine refuses no longer raises on every frame.
